hero.lede: Tailor-made luxury safaris, authentic cultural encounters, mountain treks and idyllic beach escapes — thoughtfully curated by a small team of destination experts and brought to life by local specialists with decades of experience across Africa.

aboutLines: Each journey is shaped around who is coming: the parks, the pace and the time of year, and it is planned by people who know the ground.
Guides, camps and the day-to-day work stay near the places you visit.

philanthropy.summary: Explore Kenya. Celebrate humanity. Make a difference.
title: Beyond safaris.
Beyond conservation.
Changing lives.
lede: At Camellia Horizons, every journey should leave a positive mark: protecting wildlife, empowering communities, preserving cultures, and supporting children with special needs. The greatest journeys are the ones that leave the world a little better for everyone.
A journey with us is about more than an unforgettable safari. It is also a chance to make a meaningful difference in the lives of communities across Kenya.

sections.kicker: Every journey creates an opportunity to give back
sections.title: Giving back to our communities
text: The beauty of travel lies in the places you explore and in the lives you touch along the way.

Our commitment to responsible travel goes beyond protecting wildlife and preserving Kenya’s natural heritage. We are equally committed to supporting local communities, standing with vulnerable families, and creating opportunities for children and people living with disabilities.

sections.kicker: Every child deserves a chance to shine
sections.title: Supporting children with special needs
text: We are committed to making a positive difference in the lives of children with special needs, including children with Down syndrome, autism, and other developmental or physical disabilities.

Every child deserves love, dignity, inclusion, and the chance to thrive. Each child has abilities, dreams and potential of their own. We hope to help create a future where children of all abilities are valued, supported, and given room to flourish, through learning, belonging and personal growth.
That hope includes inclusive education, the resources a family needs, social inclusion, and stronger families. How a particular journey can contribute is something we explain when you enquire.

sections.title: Empowering families and local communities
text: Our vision also reaches families facing social and economic challenges. We hope to strengthen livelihoods, widen access to education, and support community-led efforts that create lasting change.

sections.title: Travel with purpose
text: When you explore Kenya with Camellia Horizons, you become part of a journey that values people as much as places.
We believe tourism can be a force for good: connecting travellers with communities, and encouraging compassion, understanding and a meaningful contribution.
sections.close: Explore Kenya. Celebrate humanity. Make a difference.

seasons.heading: When to go
seasons.intro: Pick a month to see what the weather, the crowds and the wildlife are usually like. Patterns shift from year to year, so we confirm details when we plan your trip.

months.note: Calving begins on the southern plains, which draws lions and cheetahs close to the young.
Peak of the calving season, with the herds spread across the short-grass plains.
Green landscapes and good rates. Showers tend to come in the afternoon.
The wettest stretch. Some camps close, but those open offer great value and empty roads.
Lush scenery, excellent birdlife and herds beginning to move north-west.
Roads dry out and the herds travel through the western corridor.
Herds reach the northern rivers and river crossings become possible.
Peak safari month. Book early for the best camps and the best crossing locations.
Crossings continue and the grass is short, so predators are easy to watch.
Fewer vehicles at the northern rivers before the short rains begin.
Herds head south again. Brief storms, fresh green plains and lower prices.
Festive season brings crowds, but wildlife on the southern plains is excellent.
